items.title: Formalize Structure Order Fact Family
items.scope: Formalize threshold-free rolling range width, width evolution and center movement required by Stage 0/2 research while reusing accepted directional-efficiency facts.
acceptance: A/B freeze semantics and implementation before qualification
C reproduces the fact family from two accepted immutable cold-source artifacts with no DWD/provider access
D binds only accepted runtime concepts and closes all implementation/qualification authority
No Stage 0/2 projection/search, LabelCard, holdout, daily, strategy or trading authority opens

items.title: Freeze Structure Order Fact Family semantics
items.scope: Freeze midpoint-normalized range width, nonoverlap width-change, range-center-shift and explicit reuse of Trend Evolution directional efficiency.
acceptance: Existing range-width/width-change concepts are reused rather than duplicated
Only missing range-center-shift concept is added
Contraction/center stability do not imply accumulation or Stage 2
Directional efficiency remains owned by Trend Evolution
Stage thresholds and usage clocks stay outside Fact identity

items.title: Implement Structure Order Facts, deep verifier and fixed Worker route
items.scope: Implement typed range organization observations, partial availability/reset semantics, immutable-source A/B qualification and fixed Event Worker dispatch.
acceptance: Formal calculations exactly match frozen third-group range geometry
Prior-zero-width, reset, prefix-replay and no-Stage counterexamples pass
Deep verifier first validates each original F9 source artifact
Worker admits only the fixed Structure Order qualification config
Qualification code has no market-data/provider opening path

items.title: Qualify Structure Order Facts from two immutable cold-source artifacts
items.scope: Execute one governed qualification Job that replays only the two accepted F9 source artifacts and requires byte-identical Structure Order facts and deterministic review samples.
acceptance: Both source F9 artifacts pass original deep verification
Source-input payloads and reconstructed Structure Order payloads match exactly across A/B
Fact counts and deterministic review sample are durably bound
Market-data read and DWD-provider-open counters remain zero
No Stage 0/2 projection/search output is emitted

items.title: Freeze accepted Structure Order runtime bindings
items.scope: After C passes, bind only the qualified Structure Order concepts in the Structure blueprint/Catalog and close the milestone without opening Stage 0/2 threshold search.
acceptance: Blueprint binds only range-width, width-change and range-center-shift under the qualified subset
Accepted B1-B5, Support Evolution and Trend Evolution identities remain unchanged
Stage 0/2 proposition research remains separately gated
High-side activity relation remains a later optional question
All implementation/qualification authority closes after acceptance
